title: fix(platform-objects): withhold the sign-in phone fields from org peers in the user directory
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the `sys_user` phone fields or the user directory's field security (`git grep -i -c 'phone_number\|phoneNumber' -- 'skills/**'`: zero hits, exit 1; control `git grep -c sys_user -- 'skills/**'`: hits), so no skill text describes the served set this narrows.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`sys_user.phone_number` / `phone_number_verified` 从 `Account` 字段组移入 `Admin` 字段组；普通成员读用户目录时不再拿到其他用户的登录手机号。
- 为什么改：手机号是 better-auth 的登录标识，不是通讯录数据；`Admin` 组已由内置权限集做字段级只读屏蔽（成员屏蔽、管理员保留），沿用同一机制，不新增规则。
- 风险与回滚：这是一次接受集收窄（BREAKING，按 `patch` 发布）：成员按这两个字段过滤、排序、分组、聚合会被 403 拒绝，`$search` 静默不再扫手机号列，成员读自己那行也看不到手机号（本人手机号从登录会话读取）；回滚 = 把两个字段的 group 改回 `Account`。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（两个字段的 `group`）；`.changeset/user-directory-sign-in-phone-fields.md`（BREAKING 横幅与 FROM/TO）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/identity-admin-fields-org-peer.dogfood.test.ts`（成员按姓名搜同事命中、按手机号搜无结果）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/identity-admin-field-group.test.ts`，预期 19 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（本人行问题已在 6497499302 裁决「接受」）。

## What changes

The user directory no longer returns another user's sign-in phone number to non-admin readers. Security hardening, declared as an accept-set narrowing.

- `sys_user.phone_number` and `sys_user.phone_number_verified` (the better-auth phone sign-in identifier and its verified flag) move from the `Account` field group to the `Admin` field group.
- The `Admin` group is already the declaration the shipped permission sets read (`identityAdminFieldSecurity` in `plugin-security`'s `default-permission-sets.ts`): `member_default`, `viewer_readonly` and `external_default` mark every group field `readable: false, editable: false`; `admin_full_access`, `organization_admin` and its no-bypass variant keep it. No new rule, list or field attribute: the server's existing field-level security (field masker, predicate guard, activity redaction, metadata-plane masking) does the work, so the Console needs no change.
- **Positions that narrow for a non-admin member** (the changeset carries the full FROM / TO under its `**BREAKING** (an accept-set narrowing)` banner):
  - row position: both fields are withheld from every `sys_user` row served, the member's own row included (field-level read is row-blind, ADR-0066);
  - filter, sort, group-by and aggregate positions naming either field are refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`;
  - `$search`: the default search set is narrowed silently, so a user picker keeps answering on `name` and `email` and a search for a colleague's number returns no row.
- `banned` / `ban_reason` / `ban_expires`: reviewed, no change. `banned` stays served to org peers by an earlier ruling (directory status every user picker filters on); `ban_reason` and `ban_expires` are already in the `Admin` group and already withheld.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` `patch` (a non-protocol narrowing ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner); exactly one ADR-0087 disposition, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no metadata key, spelling, export or stored shape moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Own row (ruled).** Field-level read security is row-blind (ADR-0066, 2026-10-26 note: `readable` stays row-blind; `when` beside `readable: false` is refused at parse). So a member's OWN row on the generic data API is withheld the phone fields too, exactly as for every other `Admin`-group field. The maintainer ruled this accepted in comment 6497499302 (「接受」): ship as is, the own number stays reachable through the auth session, no row-aware read vote. better-auth's phone-number plugin declares `phoneNumber` / `phoneNumberVerified` with `returned: true`, so the session user carries them when the plugin is enabled.
- System-context readers (sign-in, SMS delivery, admin import, the auth adapter) are unaffected.
- A deployment that wants members to read colleagues' phone numbers grants a set naming the two fields `readable: true` (field grants merge most-permissively).
- Rework round (contract review 6501154665, FAIL on the declaration alone): this head adds the `(narrowing)` arm, the BREAKING banner with FROM / TO and the ADR-0087 marker to the changeset, the `Skills-docs:` line here, and the should-fix `$search` cases at the HTTP door. No package source changed in this round. Rework run dispatched from PM session session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/identity-admin-field-group.test.ts`: the two phone fields are declared inside the group; a member (`member_default`) is withheld both and the field masker strips them from a colleague row; each admin set keeps both and the masker serves them.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/identity-admin-fields-org-peer.dogfood.test.ts` (real showcase boot, HTTP door): the colleague fixture carries a synthetic phone; a member's directory read projecting the phone fields is served the colleague's id, name and email without them; the org owner and the platform admin read the stored values. New this round: a member `$search` on `sys_user` by the colleague's name is served `200` with the colleague listed; a member `$search` by the colleague's synthetic number is served `200` with no row; the platform admin's `$search` by the same number lists the colleague (the control that the term matches when the column is scanned). The existing generic group pins (member reads colleague, list door, activity door, member own row, filter refusal) cover the phone fields too.
